page: OVHcloud b2-15 is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs, utilizing an Intel Haswell processor running at 2.0 GHz without hyperthreading. The hardware configuration includes 15.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB of RAM per core, and is bundled with 100 GB of local SSD storage. It also includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results indicate that the instance delivers modest compute capabilities. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance falls into the bottom 10%, while multi-core performance and PassMark CPU scores rank in the bottom 25%. Memory performance is mixed; small-block cached read-only bandwidth is average, but large-block uncached read and write bandwidths are weak. Database operations and small-model LLM inference with 135M parameters perform at average levels, whereas larger workloads like 7B model inference show poor throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the b2-15 offers dedicated CPU resources on older hardware, presenting a stable but lower-performing alternative to modern compute-optimized instances. This resource profile is best suited for general-purpose workloads with moderate resource demands, such as basic web serving, lightweight database operations, and development or testing environments that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation without requiring high-frequency processing.
